notes: 0.9.33 — two groups see a change in results: setups whose subwoofer level already sits at the receiver's +12 dB limit (a bass lift is now delivered inside the subwoofer filter's own headroom) and two-subwoofer setups (the bass search now sweeps every timing and polarity combination, so a good setup is never missed — run again if you have two subs). For everyone else this version calculates and transfers what 0.9.32 does, to the byte. Transfers that stall are re-sent once by the app, a failed attempt is recorded, and the results note names the subwoofer that limits a bass level.
